findings.issue: R6 says mappings-demo.yaml maps every field to demo-esg- spreadsheet IDs, but the test checks spreadsheet and sheet IDs for only three hard-coded energy_total names. If any other field (or any rpt_ target or prior field) were mapped to a non-demo ID, or to the wrong sheet (CY vs PY vs source), no test would fail. The per-field loop checks only existence, description and range.
findings.fix: In the per-field loop, for mappings-demo.yaml, assert Source is on demo-esg-source/demo-esg-source-2025, Target on demo-esg-report/demo-esg-report-cy and Prior on demo-esg-report/demo-esg-report-py. This implies the demo-esg- prefix for every field. Then drop or keep the three-name block.

findings.issue: Three //nolint:gosec trailing comments (lines 35, 121, 158) suppress a linter. They were not asked for, and the working rules forbid ignore comments to get green. Lint passes without them (0 issues).
findings.fix: Delete the nolint comments. If a note that the path is trusted is wanted, use a plain comment that suppresses nothing.
